p0197.note: Anyone staying at a backcountry campsite in Yellowstone must get a backcountry use permit.

p0134.note: A permit is required for all overnight stays in the backcountry.

p0073.note: Waterton Lakes: backcountry camping by permit at designated sites.

p0047.note: Tayrona: camping zones are delimited; fires only in authorized zones.
